'''Peter Kuchment''' (born 1949) is an American [[mathematician]] working in [[Partial differential equation|partial differential equations]], [[mathematical physics]], [[geometric analysis]], and [[integral geometry]] with applications to [[medical imaging]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Peter Kuchment |url=https://people.tamu.edu/~kuchment/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250126020420/https://people.tamu.edu/~kuchment/ |archive-date=2025-01-26 |access-date=2025-06-05 |website=people.tamu.edu}}</ref>

Peter Kuchment was born in 1949 in [[Chernivtsi|Chernivtsi (formerly Chernovtsy)]], Soviet Union (now Ukraine). He then studied at a university and worked in Voronezh (Russia), until emigrating to the US in 1989. He holds a M.S. in [[mathematics]] from [[Voronezh State University]] (1971), a Ph.D. from [[VN Karazin Kharkiv National University|Kharkiv State University]], Ukraine (1973), and Doctor of Science from The Institute of Mathematics<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://imath.kiev.ua/?lang=en|title=Institute of Mathematics NAS of Ukraine|website=imath.kiev.ua}}</ref> of the Ukrainian Acad. Sci., [[Kyiv]] (1983) (the latter two degrees in Mathematics and Physics).{{Citation needed|date=June 2025}}

== Employment ==

* 1971–1972: School teacher of mathematics, Voronezh, USSR{{Citation needed|date=June 2025}}
* 1972–1989: Faculty (Assistant, Associate, Full Professor and chair) at the Mathematics and Theoretical Mechanics Department of Voronezh Forestry Institute (now [[Voronezh State University of Forestry and Technologies|Voronezh State University of Forestry and Technology]]).{{Citation needed|date=June 2025}}
* 1990–2001: Associate and later Full Professor at the Mathematics and Statistics Department of Wichita State University.<ref>{{Cite web |title=IEEE Author information |url=https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/37088171679 |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=ieeexplore.ieee.org}}</ref>
* 2001–present: Full Professor, later Distinguished Professor (2011), Arthur George and Mary Emolene  Owen Chair<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hansen '24 |first=Emily |title=Recognizing Excellence: Seven Arts And Sciences Faculty Named To Endowed Chairs |url=https://artsci.tamu.edu/news/2025/03/recognizing-excellence-seven-arts-and-sciences-faculty-named-to-endowed-chairs.html |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=artsci.tamu.edu |language=en}}</ref> (2025) of the Mathematics Department at the [[Texas A&M University]].

== Publications ==
Kuchment has published 168 peer-reviewed papers.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Peer-reviewed papers by Peter Kuchment |url=https://people.tamu.edu/~kuchment/papers.htm |access-date=2025-06-05 |website=people.tamu.edu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=MathSciNet |url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/publications-search?query=kuchment,%20peter&page=1&size=20&sort=newest&facets= |access-date=2025-06-10 |website=connect.liblynx.com}}</ref> He has four books published and one translated.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Kha |first1=Minh |last2=Kuchment |first2=Peter |date=2021 |title=Liouville-Riemann-Roch Theorems on Abelian Coverings |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-030-67428-1 |series=Lecture Notes in Mathematics |volume=2245 |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-030-67428-1 |isbn=978-3-030-67427-4 |issn=0075-8434}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Kuchment |first=Peter |url=https://epubs.siam.org/doi/book/10.1137/1.9781611973297 |title=The Radon Transform and Medical Imaging |date=2013-12-27 |publisher=Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics |isbn=978-1-61197-328-0 |location=Philadelphia, PA |language=en |doi=10.1137/1.9781611973297}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last=Kuchment |first=Peter |date=1993 |title=Floquet Theory for Partial Differential Equations |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-0348-8573-7  |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-0348-8573-7|isbn=978-3-0348-9686-3 |url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Helgason |first=Sigurdur |title=Groups and Geometric Analysis |publisher=Mir |year=1986 |location=Moscow |language=Russian}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last1=Berkolaiko |first1=G. |last2=Kuchment |first2=P. |title=Introduction to Quantum Graphs |url=https://bookstore.ams.org/SURV/186 |access-date=2025-06-09 |website=bookstore.ams.org |language=en}}</ref>

== Advising ==
Kuchment advised on 21 PhD theses.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=15025|title=Peter Kuchment - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>
